item.title: Amazon Cognito now supports multi-Region replication
item.description:
📝 Amazon Cognito now supports multi-Region replication Posted on: Jun 4, 2026 Amazon Cognito now supports multi-Region replication, enabling you to synchronize user and machine identity data — including credentials, user pool configurations, and federation setups — to a secondary user pool in a standby Region you designate in near real-time. Multi-Region replication is available as an add-on for user pools in Essentials or Plus feature tiers. To get started, configure multi-Region replication using the AWS Management Console, AWS Command Line Interface (CLI), or AWS Software Development Kits (SDKs) by adding a replica user pool.
🔗 Read more: https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2026/06/amazon-cognito-multi-region/
